Sharp as Lord Augustus Highcastle, and Charles Rock as Horatio Floyd Beamish.

4343-how-and-when-to-be-your-own-doctor.title: How And When To Be Your Own Doctor
4343-how-and-when-to-be-your-own-doctor.creator: Dr. Isabelle A. Moser with Steve Solomon
4343-how-and-when-to-be-your-own-doctor.description: A book by Dr. Isabelle A. Moser with Steve Solomon. He gave me his usual half-hour get-acquainted checkout and opined that there almost certainly was nothing wrong with me. I suspect I had the good fortune to encounter an honest doctor, because he also said if it were my wish he could send me around for numerous tests but most likely these would not reveal anything either.

arxiv-1608-02943.title: Estimating the fidelity of T T gates using standard interleaved randomized benchmarking
arxiv-1608-02943.creator: Robin Harper, Steven T. Flammia
arxiv-1608-02943.description: Abstract Randomized benchmarking (RB) is an important protocol for robustly characterizing the error rates of quantum gates. The technique is typically applied to the Clifford gates since they form a group that satisfies a convenient technical condition of forming a unitary 2-design, in addition to having a tight connection to fault-tolerant quantum computing and an efficient classical simulation.

arxiv-2107-11238.title: Exploring Deep Registration Latent Spaces
arxiv-2107-11238.creator: Théo Estienne, Maria Vakalopoulou, Stergios Christodoulidis, Enzo Battistella, Théophraste Henry, Marvin Lerousseau, Amaury Leroy, Guillaume Chassagnon, Marie-Pierre Revel, Nikos Paragios, Eric Deutsch
arxiv-2107-11238.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Théo Estienne, Maria Vakalopoulou, Stergios Christodoulidis, Enzo Battistella, Théophraste Henry, Marvin Lerousseau, Amaury Leroy, Guillaume Chassagnon, Marie-Pierre Revel, Nikos Paragios, Eric Deutsch. Explainability of deep neural networks is one of the most challenging and interesting problems in the field. In this study, we investigate the topic focusing on the interpretability of deep learning-based registration methods.

arxiv-2302-12236.title: On the Cosmetic Crossing Conjecture for Special Alternating Links
arxiv-2302-12236.creator: Joe Boninger
arxiv-2302-12236.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Joe Boninger. We prove that a family of links, which includes all special alternating knots, does not admit non-nugatory crossing changes which preserve the isotopy type of the link. Our proof incorporates a result of Lidman and Moore on crossing changes to knots with L L -space branched double-covers, as well as tools from Scharlemann and Thompson’s proof of the cosmetic crossing conjecture for the unknot.

arxiv-2408-17344.title: rerankers : A Lightweight Python Library to Unify Ranking Methods
arxiv-2408-17344.creator: Benjamin Clavié
arxiv-2408-17344.description: Abstract This paper presents rerankers , a Python library which provides an easy-to-use interface to the most commonly used re-ranking approaches. Re-ranking is an integral component of many retrieval pipelines; however, there exist numerous approaches to it, relying on different implementation methods.

arxiv-2505-06650.title: Asymmetric Biphoton Generation under Ground-State Decoherence and Phase Mismatch in a Cold Atomic Ensemble
arxiv-2505-06650.creator: Jiun-Shiuan Shiu, Chang-Wei Lin, Yong-Fan Chen
arxiv-2505-06650.description: Abstract We present an experimental investigation of how ground-state decoherence and phase mismatch influence biphoton generation in double- Λ \Lambda spontaneous four-wave mixing (SFWM) within a cold atomic ensemble. Our results reveal significant asymmetry in the Stokes and anti-Stokes photon generation rates, arising from the distinct effects of phase mismatch and ground-state decoherence.

arxiv-2512-16668.title: Obstacle Mean Curvature Flow: Efficient Approximation and Convergence Analysis
arxiv-2512-16668.creator: Fabius Krämer, Tim Laux
arxiv-2512-16668.description: Abstract . We introduce a simple and efficient numerical method to compute mean curvature flow with obstacles. The method augments the Merrimam-Bence-Osher scheme with a pointwise update that enforces the constraint and therefore retains the computational complexity of the original scheme.

arxiv-2601-08822.title: The drastic impact of Eddington-limit induced mass ejections on massive star populations
arxiv-2601-08822.creator: D. Pauli, N. Langer, A. Schootemeijer, P. Marchant, H. Jin, A. Ercolino, A. Picco, R. Willcox, H. Sana
arxiv-2601-08822.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by D. Pauli, N. Langer, A. Schootemeijer, P. Marchant, H. Jin, A. Ercolino, A. Picco, R. Willcox, H. Sana. Massive stars emit copious amounts of radiation, profoundly affecting their environment in galaxies and contributing to the reionization of the Universe. However, their evolution and thus their ionizing feedback are still not fully understood.

pmc-10615487.title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking approaches predict the mechanisms of Corididius chinensis in treating manganese-induced nervous system diseases: A review
pmc-10615487.creator: Mei Zhang, Huixian Lou, Jing Ma, Keyi Xiong, Xiaohui Hou
pmc-10615487.description: Neurotoxicity could be induced by long exposure to manganese (Mn). The traditional Chinese medicine, Corididius chinensis (Cc) has been proven to have a certain curative effect on Mn poisoning. Therefore, network pharmacology was performed to explore potential therapeutic targets and pharmacological mechanisms of Cc.

pmc-10675283.title: Research on an Intelligent Mining Complete System of a Fully Mechanized Mining Face in Thin Coal Seam
pmc-10675283.creator: Bo Ren, Ke Ding, Lianguo Wang, Shuai Wang, Chongyang Jiang, Jiaxing Guo
pmc-10675283.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The mining environment of thin coal seam working faces is generally harsh, the labor intensity is high, and the production efficiency is low. Previous studies have shown that thin coal seam mining finds it difficult to follow machines, does not have complete sets of equipment, has a low degree of automation, and has difficult system co-control, which easily causes production safety accidents.

pmc-11311629.title: 4-Phenylbutyric Acid Treatment Reduces Low-Molecular-Weight Proteinuria in a Clcn5 Knock-in Mouse Model for Dent Disease-1
pmc-11311629.creator: Ana Perdomo-Ramírez, Elena Ramos-Trujillo, Jose David Machado, Victor García-Nieto, Glorián Mura-Escorche, Félix Claverie-Martin
pmc-11311629.description: Dent disease-1 (DD-1) is a rare X-linked tubular disorder characterized by low-molecular-weight proteinuria (LMWP), hypercalciuria, nephrolithiasis and nephrocalcinosis. This disease is caused by inactivating mutations in the CLCN5 gene which encodes the voltage-gated ClC-5 chloride/proton antiporter. Currently, the treatment of DD-1 is only supportive and focused on delaying the progression of the disease.

pmc-11550251.title: A Phase 3, Open-Label, Single-Arm Trial of the Efficacy and Safety of Triptorelin 6-Month Formulation in Chinese Children with Central Precocious Puberty
pmc-11550251.creator: Xiao Yu, Xinran Cheng, Haiyan Wei, Xu Xu, Chunxiu Gong, Guimei Li, Hui Yao, Li Zhou, Yan Zhong, Yu Yang, Feihong Luo, Yining Zhang, Frank Huang, Xiaofeng Shi, Patrick Cabri, Xiaoping Luo
pmc-11550251.description: IntroductionThis phase 3 study assessed the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics of the 6-month prolonged release (PR) formulation in Chinese children with central precocious puberty (CPP).MethodsIn this open-label study (NCT05029622), Chinese children (girls < 9 years, boys < 10 years) received two doses of triptorelin pamoate 22.5 mg (day 1 and month 6).

pmc-11561202.title: Sodium-Glucose Co-transporter-2 Inhibitors in Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus: The Framework for Recommendations for Their Potential Use
pmc-11561202.creator: Djordje S Popovic, Dimitrios Patoulias, Theocharis Koufakis, Paschalis Karakasis, Nikolaos Papanas
pmc-11561202.description: The growing prevalence of overweight/obesity, the persistence of inadequate glycemic control among the majority of affected individuals, and the still unacceptably high risk of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality among population with type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1D), impose an urgent need for the introduction of non-insulin glucose-lowering agents in the therapeutic armamentarium.

pmc-12979060.creator: Ece Yurtseven, Dilek Ural, Kurtuluş Karaüzüm, İrem Yılmaz, Yengi Umut Çelikyurt, Kaan Hancı, Müjdat Aktaş, Ümit Yaşar Sinan, Serdar Küçükoğlu, Ayşen Ağaçdiken Ağır
pmc-12979060.description: Results section was a typographical error. The correct number of patients with NS-AF at inclusion was 133, and this has been corrected in the published version. After propensity score matching, 20 cases were excluded, yielding 113 patients in the NS-AF group and 113 controls for all subsequent analyses.

pmc-13266859.title: The COCOON trial: wrapping potent EGFR therapy in proactive supportive care
pmc-13266859.creator: Kushal Kriplani, Won Jin Jeon, Jeremy Cetnar, Chetan Vakkalagadda, Rajat Thawani
pmc-13266859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). For nearly a decade, the standard of care (SoC) for locally advanced, metastatic, or unresectable NSCLC with classical EGFR mutations has been osimertinib monotherapy. More recently, two combination therapies showed efficacy: osimertinib with chemotherapy and amivantamab with lazertinib. The latter was studied in the frontline setting in EGFR-mutated NSCLC in the MARIPOSA trial, which demonstrated that amivantamab and lazertinib provided superior clinical outcomes to osimertinib alone.

pmc-13350714.creator: Yun-Nan Li, Shi-Liang Li, Qiao-Yin Zhou

pmc-13594819.title: Elucidating shared genetic signals between type 2 diabetes and three neurodegenerative dementia phenotypes
pmc-13594819.creator: Ana Luiza Arruda, Archit Singh, Ozvan Bocher, Benjamin F. Voight, Andrew P. Morris, Eleftheria Zeggini
pmc-13594819.description: SummaryType 2 diabetes (T2D) and dementia frequently co-occur, yet the biological mechanisms underlying this comorbidity remain incompletely understood. Here, we systematically investigate shared genetic signals between T2D and three forms of neurodegenerative dementia (Alzheimer disease, Lewy body dementia, and sporadic frontotemporal dementia) using large-scale genome-wide association studies of clinically diagnosed individuals.
